description:
Advances: specled.config

Scope expansion #3, from the specled_-q0q.5 test-critic review. lib/specled_ex/config.ex:120 moduledoc (hexdocs-rendered) still says "the 12 guardrail codes (10 append_only/* + 2 overlap/*)" — stale since specled_-q0q.2; the truth is 13 (11 append_only + 2 overlap). No existing child may touch it (S3 excludes lib). Full contract in the first comment.

comments.text:
CONTRACT (orchestrator-authored; treat as the ticket body)

Deliverable: lib/specled_ex/config.ex ~line 120 — update the moduledoc sentence "the 12 guardrail codes (10 append_only/* + 2 overlap/*)" to the true figures: 13 guardrail codes (11 append_only/* + 2 overlap/*). Verify the counts yourself against the emitters in lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex and lib/specled_ex/overlap.ex before writing them. Scan the REST of config.ex whole-file for any other count/code-list claim about these namespaces and fix any that are false the same way (report each in the completion record); touch nothing else.

Spec co-change is AUTHORIZED where the gate forces it: the smallest edit to .spec/specs/config.spec.md (or any other subject the branch guard names) that keeps branch_guard_missing_subject_update green; .spec/realization_hashes.json refresh only if a named binding drifts (a moduledoc-only change should not). A Spec-Drift trailer for branch_guard_missing_decision_update with a one-line reason is the expected remedy if that finding fires — .spec/decisions/** is out of scope.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: mix test test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs (and any config-related test the compile graph selects)
- Iteration tier: compile + mix spec.check --no-run-commands
- Final tier: bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh run-until-green, plus mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix test, mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused, make xref

Allowed touches:
- lib/specled_ex/config.ex (moduledoc/comment prose count claims ONLY — zero behavior change)
- .spec/specs/config.spec.md (gate-forced minimal co-change only)
- .spec/realization_hashes.json (only if forced)

Out of Scope (files): everything else, including VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, docs/**, .spec/decisions/**, all other lib/ and test/ files
Out of Scope (intent): no behavior change of any kind; no test additions required (prose-only sweep); no other doc edits.

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors; bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused, make xref
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
